title: Data Analyst - SC Cleared
description:
• Swansea location - hybrid working model
  • Active SC required
  • Up to £60k DoE + 6% pension, 30 days leave
  • Experience required in Python, SQL, Power BI/Tableau, Data Visualisation, Statistical Analysis


Role Opportunity

Join a growing public sector technology consultancy delivering digital, data and technology transformation across central government. You'll take on complex, hands-on analytical challenges, using data to generate actionable insights and support better decision-making across public services.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct advanced data analysis, statistical analysis and modelling to generate actionable insights
  • Develop BI dashboards and data visualisations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar
  • Cleanse, validate and integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality and integrity
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations and outcomes for clients
  • Work directly with stakeholders to understand requirements and develop tailored analytical solutions


Key Skills Required:

  • Data Analysis - advanced analysis, statistics and data modelling
  • Python / SQL - hands-on data analysis and manipulation
  • Data Visualisation - Power BI, Tableau or similar
  • Data Quality - cleansing, validation and standardisation
  • Statistical Analysis - regression, hypothesis testing and time series
  • Stakeholder Management - presenting insights to technical and non-technical audiences
